<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def o2pos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<=20 and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<36 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<40:
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
print("O2 start:", o2pos(current_frame))
for i in range(4):
    r=action(['UP'])
    p=o2pos(current_frame)
    print(f"UP {i+1}: O2 {p} changed {r.get('board_changed')}")
    if not r.get('board_changed'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
